verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his Q and passive before closing the gap; you win if you poke with E and punish the seconds after his Disdain is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Urgot outranges you at every stage except your E, and his W (Purge) cooldown shrinks to 0s at max rank, so he wins any fight that runs long. Your only route to parity is short, explosive trades — poke with E (Sky Splitter), then close with Q (Thundering Smash) the instant his E (Disdain) is down, rather than slugging it out in extended skirmishes.

theirWindow.when: Pre-6, while you're inside Urgot's Q range
theirWindow.what: Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range) slows and chips you from outside your own W or Q range, and his passive Echoing Flames adds extra physical damage on every auto he lands. Don't walk up to trade autos until you've closed with E or Q.

yourWindow.what: Once Disdain is down he has no shield and no way to hurl you off — land E (Sky Splitter) to slow and poke, then close with Q (Thundering Smash) for a free stun and all-in with W before he can reset the gap.

start.why: Posts a notably higher win rate (49.7% over 179 games) than the Doran's Ring line, and the AD/lifesteal feeds Volibear's on-hit W trades better than the ring's mana/AP, which you don't need.

boots.why: Urgot's threat is almost entirely physical — Q, autos, and passive Echoing Flames — so flat armor cuts his poke and his auto-reliant Purge harder than Lucidity Boots' cooldown haste does.

core.why: Highest win rate core path (48.7% over 78 games) and sets up the attack-speed scaling your on-hit W trades need.
Attack speed and crit push your short-trade DPS up so you can win the fight in the first few seconds rather than outlast Purge.
Heal and shield power amplifies your W sustain and E shield, offsetting Urgot's constant poke damage.

situational.when: you need more raw sustain against his poke-heavy laning pattern
urgot or his team is building heavy lifesteal or crit and out-trading you in extended fights
the game runs long and you need omnivamp to offset chip damage from his kit

runes.keystoneWhy: Its stacking attack speed rewards Volibear's extended on-hit W trades, letting him win attack-speed-scaling skirmishes in the brief windows before Urgot's kiting Q poke and Purge spam take over.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick (63.2% pick rate) and gives you kill pressure once you've closed the gap with E into Q. If you'd rather prioritize surviving his all-in and R threshold, Exhaust+Flash carries the higher measured win rate (48.3% over 22.2% pick rate).

playing.title: Lead with E, not Q
playing.detail: Open poke with E (Sky Splitter) since its 1200 range outranges Urgot's 800-range Q. Save Q (Thundering Smash) for when you're actually committing to close the gap.

playing.title: Check his E before you engage
playing.detail: Confirm Urgot's E (Disdain) is on cooldown before committing your Q stun — if it's up, he shields and hurls you away, wasting your engage.

playing.title: Mark and reset with W
playing.detail: Land W (Frenzied Maul) to mark him, then immediately recast on the same target for bonus damage and the heal. This is why Volibear's own skill order maxes W first.

playing.title: Don't slug it out at high levels
playing.detail: Urgot's Purge (W) cooldown drops to 0s at max rank, letting him fire indefinitely in long fights. Win the trade in the first few seconds or disengage.

playing.title: Respect Fear Beyond Death at any HP
playing.detail: Urgot's R has 2500 range and executes low-health targets — don't sit below the threshold even far from lane, since he can threaten you from off-screen.

playing.title: Punish every Disdain he burns
playing.detail: Disdain is his only gap-close or escape, on a 14-16s cooldown. Every time he spends it to clear wave or poke, that's your all-in window before he can reset.

playing.title: Prioritize armor into his physical kit
playing.detail: Plated Steelcaps first, and lean Thornmail if he's out-damaging you in extended fights — his passive, Q, and autos are all physical.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games this patch (OP.GG); the tactical reading of cooldown windows and trade patterns is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s (P) and (E). Use [E] to contest lane and close in with [Q] once Urgot’s abilities are on cooldown.
